title: ClientActionFunctionArgs
summary: Client action arguments with access to the server action.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Extends LoaderFunctionArgs with serverAction<T>(): Promise<T>. The installed application transport forwards the request to the registered server action when this callback is invoked.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Keep mutations in actions rather than components. Calling serverAction is optional; a client-only action may perform client-side work instead. The callback requires transport wiring and the generic is a type assertion, not runtime response validation.
